config_selection.rationale: plan §11 Amendment 3: GPT-2-small baseline 3-gram rep ~0.60, so the §4 rep gate (trips at >1.36) never fires even under single-token collapse. Auto-rule picked c=100 (rate 100%) but at c=100 all conditions degenerate into single-token loops (E_native rep 0.883 reception-loop, control rep 0.932) — the wedding KEYWORD metric is blind to this (SAKE trap). c=40 saturates the behavior (99.3%) with coherent on-topic text (rep 0.684 ~ baseline) and is the faithful operating point / primary cell.
config_selection.c100_verdict: Genuine (ARTIFACT of over-driving: control collapses to non-wedding loop so rho->0; do not trust)
config_selection.driver_rule_fixed: run_sae.py reproduction selector changed from (highest clean gain, tie->lowest c) to coherence-constrained (lowest coeff with gain>=threshold AND rep<=1.5*baseline, Amendment-3 hard constraint). On a full grid this now auto-selects c=40. The completed primary run used --fixed-coeff 40 so its chosen.note reflects the single-cell path; rationale is here + in report Config-Selection section.

rho_vs_dose_curve.note: Full battery run at 4 doses to show the verdict does not hinge on one hand-picked dose (addresses the auto-selector selecting into degeneracy). rho falls monotonically as dose rises and generations collapse into single-token loops; the fall is a control-collapse artifact (control loops on a non-wedding token while E_native loops on reception), not genuine sustained content. Only c=40 is coherent.
rho_vs_dose_curve.headline: Mixed in the coherent-steering regime (rho~0.4 at c=40); Genuine at high dose is a control-collapse artifact.
